name: io.github.team-telnyx/telnyx-mcp
title: Telnyx
description: MCP Apps: ui:// HTML text/html;profile=mcp-app via _meta.ui.resourceUri.
instructions: Connect to https://api.telnyx.com/v2/mcp using streamable-http transport. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY>` — get a key programmatically via the bot-challenge signup at https://telnyx.com/agent-signup.md, or interactively at https://portal.telnyx.com. Treat https://telnyx.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json as the canonical server card and https://telnyx.com/.well-known/mcp.json as the lightweight discovery index. Tool usage: call `list_api_endpoints` to discover endpoints (optionally filtered by `search_query`), then `get_api_endpoint_schema` for the chosen endpoint, then `invoke_api_endpoint` to call it. Always inspect the schema before invoking — `invoke_api_endpoint` is destructive-capable and side-effect risk depends on the endpoint chosen. MCP Apps: fetch https://api.telnyx.com/v2/mcp/apps, choose a slug, then POST JSON-RPC `initialize` to https://api.telnyx.com/v2/mcp/apps/{slug}/mcp with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` and `Content-Type: application/json`; retain the response `mcp-session-id` and send it on later JSON-RPC POSTs; POST `notifications/initialized`; then call `tools/list`, which returns app-opening tools with `_meta.ui.resourceUri`; call `resources/list` to list `ui://` resources such as `ui://number-intelligence/index.html`; call `resources/read` to fetch app HTML with MIME `text/html;profile=mcp-app`; invoke app tools with `tools/call` and include `Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY>` for Telnyx API-backed tool calls. For machine-readable capabilities, pricing, and benchmarks without the live MCP, see https://telnyx.com/ai/capabilities.json and the agent fast path at https://telnyx.com/agents/start.

auth.description: Telnyx API key. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <TELNYX_API_KEY>`. No OAuth/PKCE in v1.

tools.name: list_api_endpoints
tools.description: List or search for all endpoints in the Telnyx TypeScript API

search_query.description: An optional search query to filter the endpoints by. Provide a partial name, resource, operation, or tag to filter the endpoints returned.

tools.name: get_api_endpoint_schema
tools.description: Get the schema for an endpoint in the Telnyx TypeScript API. You can use the schema returned by this tool to invoke an endpoint with the `invoke_api_endpoint` tool.

endpoint.description: The name of the endpoint to get the schema for.

tools.name: invoke_api_endpoint
tools.description: Invoke an endpoint in the Telnyx TypeScript API. Note: use the `list_api_endpoints` tool to get the list of endpoints and `get_api_endpoint_schema` tool to get the schema for an endpoint. Safety depends on the endpoint chosen; agents MUST call `get_api_endpoint_schema` first and surface side-effect risk to the user before calling write/destructive endpoints.

endpoint_name.description: The name of the endpoint to invoke.

args.description: The arguments to pass to the endpoint. This must match the schema returned by the `get_api_endpoint_schema` tool.

tools.name: open_number_intelligence
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Number Intelligence MCP App for phone number lookup, validation, and enrichment workflows.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.

tools.name: open_usage_cost_explorer
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Usage & Cost Explorer MCP App for usage and cost analysis.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.

tools.name: open_voice_monitor
tools.description: Open the Telnyx Voice Monitor MCP App for observing and troubleshooting voice traffic.

action.description: Optional no-op app opener action; omit to open the app.

session.description: Retain the mcp-session-id returned by initialize and send it on subsequent JSON-RPC POSTs.

apps.name: Number Intelligence
apps.description: Phone-number analysis using Telnyx Number Lookup and read-first readiness signals.

apps.name: Usage & Cost Explorer
apps.description: Balance, usage reports, billing groups, and guarded billing controls.

apps.name: Voice Monitor
apps.description: Read-only active-call monitoring, call timelines, call status, and recording discovery.

evaluation_tools.description: Machine-readable evaluation endpoints for programmatically assessing Telnyx infrastructure
